newsitem.title: USA: Telex Communications to sell $125 mln debt in LBO.
newsitem.headline: Telex Communications to sell $125 mln debt in LBO.

text.p: Telex Communications Inc plans to sell $125 million in high-yield bonds in connection with a leveraged buyout of the company in the next several weeks, market sources said.
Proceeds from the offering will be used in to finance the purchase of the company as well as to refinance $100 million in outstanding Telex 12 percent senior notes due 2004.

Telex recently announced that Greenwich Street Capital Partners, a New York-based equity fund, is purchasing for $375 million all the outstanding shares of the company other than those retained by management. The purchase price also included the cost of the bond refinancing, the company said.
Chase Securities Inc, which acted as financial advisor to Greenwich, will underwrite the 144 private placement of senior subordinated notes due 2007.
The roadshow for the bond offering is expected to begin next week, market sources said.
Telex is a Minneapolis, Minn-based manufacturer of audio, wireless and multimedia communications products.
Company officials could not immediately be reached for comment.

Telex commenced a tender offer for the outstanding notes on March 31. The company offered to pay a total of $1,145.93 plus accrued interest per $1,000 principal amount of the bonds. The tender offer terminates on April 25.
